phrase: an Online Dry Fruits and Healthy Snacks Store
verdict: Yes, if you can source well. Healthy Master pitched an online dry fruits, berries and snacks store on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Dry fruits are bought regularly and for gifting, but margins depend on buying directly from markets like Delhi's Khari Baoli or from importers.
angle: Dry fruits are a large and steady market, with gifting peaks at Diwali and weddings. Quality, freshness and fair prices build loyal buyers. Flavoured nuts, trail mixes and gift boxes add margin.
